assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium modern skincare campaign photograph for the fictional brand Dewelle. Landscape composition, 3:2. Labels in dark forest clean lowercase sans serif reading exactly 'dewelle', with very small product text 'cloud cleanser', 'dew essence', 'petal gel cream'. Large simple perfectly spelled brand text d-e-w-e-l-l-e. Background peach studio with bright diffused daylight and soft sun shadows. Realistic glass, cream ceramic, dewdrops, glossy editorial art direction, contemporary playful geometry, one small lilac sphere and folded citrus-yellow ribbon. Product positions dynamic but physically believable, roomy composition all packages visible. No extra logos, no certifications, no webpage or border.
